cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I agreed to watch your dog today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow's only a few hours away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Exactly. A separate word with no place in our agreement.
